As described in the ROWD, the Phase 2 improvements include the construction of a second outfall, Discharge Point 002, near the existing outfall and construction of a new primary clarifier to increase the discharge capacity to 12.5 MGD.
The proposed Phase 3 improvements include the construction of a solids processing facility and installation of a new filter pump for tertiary treatment to increase the discharge capacity to 13.6 MGD.
The proposed Phase 4 improvements include the construction of a new secondary clarifier and aeration basin and the construction of a sludge digester to increase the discharge capacity to 16 MGD.
